template.subject: USERREMINDER_REMINDER_DETAILS_FOR
template.htmlbody:
Hello {NAME},

We have noticed that you have not completed registering at {SITENAME}.

Your account is created and must be activated before you can use it.

To activate the account click on the following link or copy-paste it in your browser:
{ACTIVATE_URL}

After activation you may login to {SITELINK} using the following username and password:

Username: {USERNAME}
Forgot your Password? : {PASSWORD_RESET_URL}

If you no longer wish to receive these reminders then unsubscribe here {OPTOUT_URL}
